items.name: Caminos de Guanajuato - Irapuato 2026

venue.name: [Instituto Irapuato](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Nk8ySpvyGzL9DGRG9)
venue.address: Av Mariano J. García 355, San Miguelito, C.P. 36557 Irapuato, Gto.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMzAzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fac7617a993cc6636e9f89c013adf99c64048618/CaminosIrapuato.jpg) ##### *🎵"Di que vienes de allá, de un mundo raro, que no sabes llorar, que no entiendes de amor, y que nunca has llorado..."🎶* ## Caminos de Guanajuato – Irapuato 2026 La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** continúa su recorrido y hace escala en **Irapuato, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Este torneo forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo. En cada parada, la música de José Alfredo Jiménez acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a Irapuato. El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en Irapuato para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ## Caminos de Guanajuato – Irapuato 2026 The "Caminos de Guanajuato" route continues its journey and makes a stop in **Irapuato, Guanajuato**, a place that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and daily life intertwine in every corner. This tournament is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different locations under the same competitive and festive spirit. At each stop, the music of José Alfredo Jiménez symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have given voice to the Guanajuato spirit, inspire this edition dedicated to Irapuato. The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in Irapuato to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. - Each competitor may bring a maximum of one companion. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers. Have fun!

items.information: ![Speedcubing Austria Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgyMzE5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--484c13de9df904a57087f1d30b8dae0d69b0c2af/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Frühling 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Speedcubing Austria sowie von Simon Praschl, Noah Kirrane und Julian Ostadal organisiert und von Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Viktor Kalmar und Fabian Staber delegiert. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Frühling 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Speedcubing Austria as well as Simon Praschl, Noah Kirrane and Julian Ostadal and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Viktor Kalmar and Fabian Staber. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsWarmupRiversideA2026#73009-competitor-responsibilities) tab. **This is a twin competition with [Westerns Warmup Riverside B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternsWarmupRiversideB2026). You may only sign up for ONE competition (A or B).** Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. **Food is NOT allowed in the venue. This competition is scheduled to take place before normal lunch hours.** This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

items.name: Weston-super-Mare Spring 2026
items.information: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **Spectators may attend for free!** [![UKCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/) [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) **PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be competitor limits for some events: ***- 4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5 Blindfolded: first 20 to register*** Spaces are available on a first come first served basis. If you are amongst the first 20 to register for either/both these events, you will get a space in them. If you are not within the first people registered, your registration for that event will be removed after the close of registration. However we will be keeping waiting list for these specific events in the case of dropouts before registration closes. Please only consider registering for these events if you are certain you would like to compete in them.

items.name: Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUzNzgzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--99a5074324a05b67cfd873b8e957f6adfb32c494/AC5CF1AE-56A9-4D6E-9278-530BC63CA9F4.png) **Deutsch** Liebe Speedcuber, liebe Würfelfans, wir freuen uns riesig, euch zum Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende am 16. und 17. Mai 2026 in Wuppertal Cronenberg einzuladen! Euch erwartet ein spannendes Wochenende voller Würfelspaß, Bestzeiten und einer großartigen Community. Ob Newcomer oder erfahrener Cuber – alle sind herzlich willkommen! Meldet euch an und seid dabei – wir freuen uns auf euch. **English** Dear speedcubers and cube fans, We’re super excited to invite you to the Wuppertal Cube Weekend on May 16–17, 2026 in Wuppertal Cronenberg! Expect an exciting weekend full of cube fun, personal bests, and an amazing community. Whether you’re a newcomer or an experienced cuber – everyone is welcome! Sign up and join us – we’re looking forward to seeing you!
